Panoptes

Development status: Beta

Panoptes is under active development and should be considered beta software. Its public API, configuration format, and bundled templates may change, including through breaking changes, while the package is being refined.

Introduction

Panoptes is an R package that provides reusable infrastructure for testing package behavior across database platforms. It gives package maintainers a consistent way to declare supported database management systems, resolve test configuration, construct DatabaseConnector test contexts, and verify that a continuous-integration workflow matches the declared support matrix.

Named after Argus Panoptes, the many-eyed guardian of Greek mythology, the package is designed to provide one view of compatibility across many database platforms.

Panoptes does not provision database servers or OMOP CDMs, manage repository secrets, or define a consuming package’s behavior and assertions. Those remain the responsibility of the package and its test environment.

Features

  • Support SQLite, DuckDB, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Oracle, Redshift, Spark, BigQuery, Snowflake, and InterSystems IRIS.
  • Validate a package-owned YAML declaration of supported database platforms.
  • Select one database platform per R process for focused live testing.
  • Resolve normalized environment variables without exposing credentials.
  • Construct a consistent, redacted DatabaseConnector test context.
  • Apply different failure policies to local, optional-CI, and required-CI execution.
  • Scope temporary credentials and R options to the lifetime of a test context.
  • Generate collision-resistant names for package-owned test objects.
  • Verify that a workflow includes every enabled external database with the declared runner and GitHub environment.

Example

Add Panoptes to the consuming package’s Suggests, then copy and customize the bundled database-platform declaration:

dir.create("inst/test-config", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
file.copy(
  system.file(
    "templates",
    "hades-database-platforms.yml",
    package = "Panoptes"
  ),
  "inst/test-config/hades-database-platforms.yml"
)

A package-owned live behavior test can then use the selected database context:

testthat::test_that("package behavior works on the selected DBMS", {
  config <- Panoptes::readDatabaseTestConfig(package = "MyPackage")
  Panoptes::skipIfNoLiveDatabase(config)

  Panoptes::withDatabaseTestContext(config, verify = TRUE, {
    on.exit({
      # Delete package-owned database objects here.
    }, add = TRUE)

    # Run package-specific behavior and assert its result here.
    testthat::expect_true(nzchar(context$cdmDatabaseSchema))
    Panoptes::requireDatabaseTestConnectionAttempted(context)
  })
})

Connection verification confirms that a connection was attempted; the package-specific assertions must still prove the behavior being tested.

Technology

Panoptes is an R package. It uses DatabaseConnector to create database connection details and testthat to implement test-focused skip and failure behavior.

System requirements

  • R version 4.1.0 or higher.
  • Java and the appropriate JDBC drivers when testing a database that requires them through DatabaseConnector.
  • The duckdb R package when testing DuckDB; DuckDB does not require a JDBC driver.
  • Access to the database servers and OMOP CDMs used by live tests.

Live database credentials are not required for ordinary package checks.

Getting Started

  1. Install the current development version from GitHub:

    remotes::install_github("OHDSI/Panoptes")

  2. Add Panoptes (>= 0.2.0) to Suggests in the consuming package’s DESCRIPTION file. Panoptes is intended to be a test-only dependency.

  3. Follow the usage vignette to declare database support, write a package-owned behavior test, configure local credentials, and set up live CI:

    vignette("using-panoptes", package = "Panoptes")

License

Development

Panoptes is developed as an R package. Changes should include unit tests and keep the configuration validator, JSON Schema, configuration template, and workflow template aligned.

Development status

Panoptes is under active development and is currently in beta. It has not yet reached a stable release contract, and maintainers should expect breaking changes as experience from additional consuming packages is incorporated.
